QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_7

question.text: As per SEBI ICDR Regulations, a Social Impact Assessor is defined as an individual registered with a Self-Regulatory Organisation (SRO) under which body?

answer.text: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) directly

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.3.1 defines SIA as 'an individual registered with a self-regulatory organization under the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or such other agency as may be specified by SEBI, who has qualified a certification program conducted by NISM and holds a valid certificate.' ICAI is the notified SRO. The Trap: ICMAI (A) is for cost auditors and is NOT the SRO for SIAs — common distractor. ICSI (B) is for company secretaries. SEBI (D) registers intermediaries directly in some segments but here delegates to ICAI as SRO for SIAs. Cross-Exam Context: NISM III-A / III-C Compliance distinguishes SROs across segments. For XXIII, the specific ICAI designation (not ICMAI, not ICSI) is the most frequent regulatory-recall question. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When verifying the identity of an SIA for a peer review or empanelment, always check the ICAI SIAB register — a certificate showing only NISM pass but no ICAI empanelment means the SIA is not yet registered to sign AIRs.
